description: Same policy as Bortle's (github.com/benhartwich/bortle, renovate.json): the hosted Mend Renovate app, one grouped PR per ecosystem once a week in the Monday-night window, security fixes at any time, the owner assigned so GitHub actually notifies him.

The N.I.N.A. packages are held for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, whatever the update type: they decide the oldest N.I.N.A. the plugin runs on. Raising them means raising MinimumApplicationVersion in Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs and the manifest folder (manifests/b/Bortle/<nina version>/), and testing in that N.I.N.A. — never a merge on green CI alone.

packageRules.description: N.I.N.A. itself: one PR for all its packages, only after approval (see above)
The actions CI and the release workflow run on
Majors stay single and wait for approval on the dashboard

N.I.N.A. 3.2 runs on .NET 8, and the plugin is built with the same .NET 8 SDK N.I.N.A. is (CI and the release workflow, actions/setup-dotnet). Lift together with N.I.N.A.'s own move to a newer runtime, not before.
